title: ArchitectureDecision
description: TOGAF-sourced justification archetype — Architecture Decision Record (ADR). Defines the property vocabulary for recording architecture decisions, their context, rationale, and lifecycle status. Rootless archetype — used to type decision records in governance justification. TOGAF mapping: Architecture Decision / Rationale (Architecture Governance, Decision Log). Formalizes the TOGAF concept of recording rationale as structured, queryable decision records. Source framework: TOGAF (Architecture Governance, Decision Log).

status.description: Decision lifecycle status. PROPOSED = under review. ACCEPTED = approved and active. SUPERSEDED = replaced by a newer decision. DEPRECATED = no longer applicable. TOGAF mapping: Decision Log status tracking.

context.description: Situation and forces that led to this decision being needed. TOGAF mapping: the architectural context and drivers.

decision.description: What was decided — the chosen course of action.

consequences.description: Known consequences of adopting this decision (both positive and negative). TOGAF mapping: impact assessment.
